title: Merge six pocock craft nuggets into expertise and reference prose
action: Implement CONTEXT.md D1-D4 (docs/history/pocock-nuggets/CONTEXT.md) exactly; match each file's existing voice, section structure, and heading style; keep every insertion to one short paragraph or a few lines. (1) expertise/planning.md — in the build-order territory ('Build order versus discovery order' or a better-fitting adjacent spot): add expand-contract sequencing for wide mechanical refactors (expand: add the new form beside the old so nothing breaks; migrate: move call sites over in batches sized by blast radius; contract: delete the old form once no caller remains — full green is promised only at contract; each step small, reversible, never a repo-wide red moment), plus the prefactor line 'make the change easy, then make the easy change'. (2) expertise/debugging.md — beside 'State the hypothesis before the fix': add that hard bugs get 3-5 ranked falsifiable hypotheses generated BEFORE testing any (single-hypothesis generation anchors on the first plausible idea), and that candidate fixes are compared only after diagnosis — never a fix menu proposed from the symptom. (3) expertise/tests.md — beside 'Pick the cheapest level that can fail': add the pre-agreed-seams ritual — before TDD on a new surface, confirm 'what is the public interface, and which seams do we test?', then test only at those seams. (4) skills/bee-shaping/references/shaping-reference.md 'Pinned terms' section: one line — a pinned term also lists the losing synonyms under _Avoid_ so the rejected words stay rejected. (5) skills/bee-capturing/references/area-spec.md Data Dictionary rules: one line — a dictionary term may carry an _Avoid_ list of rejected synonyms, seeded from shaping's pinned terms. (6) The .bee/expertise/ tree is the vendored copy of expertise/ — after editing the expertise/ sources, run the regen chain (bee dev regen; then bee dev release-manifest --write) and confirm the vendored copies and manifest are in sync; if regen does not sync .bee/expertise, sync those copies to match the sources in the same commit. One commit, imperative subject, cell id trailer.
